composition_subtypes.role: Sort each duration group by start day L to enable non-overlap checks
Maintain min cost of compatible complementary-duration vouchers using advancing pointer

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort voucher groups by start day, then two-pointer scan to find minimum cost pair with durations summing to x and non-overlapping intervals.
payload.rationale: The algorithm groups by duration, sorts each group, then for each group iterates with a two-pointer to maintain the cheapest compatible voucher from complementary duration group. Sorting enables efficient non-overlap checking; the two-pointer greedily tracks min cost.
